objective: Analyze the two requested reference repositories and implement all identified RapidLM parity gaps autonomously.
status_rules: complete means the task-specific focused evidence passed; overall completion additionally requires REF-027. No pending task may be counted as delivered. Existing GVS tasks remain governed by their own worklist.

tasks.title: Pin and analyze both requested source trees
acceptance: Pinned inventory and architecture/capability report with source paths; distinguish source reachability from live verification.

tasks.title: Preserve complete image tool payloads and supported image formats
acceptance: PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP byte round trips; refuse >3 MiB before encoding; omit images for a non-vision model.

tasks.title: Make long-line and tail file reads recoverable
acceptance: Unicode long-line pages reconstruct exactly; whole-line pages never skip a suffix; validate tail offsets, byte budget and column boundaries.

tasks.title: Restore useful bounded MCP, web, PDF and language-server content
acceptance: Retain content beyond byte 256, explicit truncation, pre-cut redaction and inert external-data markers.

tasks.title: Expose Responses profiles and repair complete response/tool replay
acceptance: Real binary selects /responses; JSON and SSE output preserve answers and arguments without duplicates; image tool output, effort and local transcript replay are encoded.

tasks.title: Connect model search to ignore-aware Context Fabric grep
acceptance: Regex, Unicode case folding, path and glob filters; every matching line; ignored/build/hidden paths excluded; byte pages recover every hit.

tasks.title: Preserve live streaming across transport type erasure
acceptance: Boxed HTTP transport delivers Responses text before server completion, decodes chunked framing and preserves split UTF-8; buffered/error behavior remains valid.

tasks.title: Add native Google GenAI protocol
acceptance: Explicit provider/profile/preset; native text/image/tool request and SSE conversion; current Google wire documentation; cancellation, classified errors, secrets and egress via existing transport; configured-binary fixture.

tasks.title: Add native Vertex model and credential routing
acceptance: Explicit project/location and regional endpoint; ADC or configured credential process with no token logging; GenAI and Anthropic-on-Vertex paths use existing adapters and managed limits; offline contract tests and credentialed live check when available.

tasks.title: Add Azure deployment/version and Bedrock protocol authentication
acceptance: Inventory exact Azure, Bedrock and Copilot routes from pinned fork; provide explicit endpoint/deployment/version and credential bindings; implement required native signing/envelopes or record a separately tested compatibility path; never label a generic gateway native parity.

tasks.title: Add provider-account OAuth and refresh
acceptance: Provider auth distinct from MCP auth; browser/device flow where supported; keychain handles, refresh/revoke, issuer/origin binding, managed refusal and restart tests; no unsolicited account login.

tasks.title: Add provider catalog import, refresh and migration guidance
acceptance: Bounded source registry with provenance and stale/offline behavior; explicit credential binding; preserve user defaults except an approved or specified migration; CLI and terminal controls; model removals diagnosed.

tasks.title: Add native video content and provider upload lifecycle
acceptance: Canonical video/upload references with declared capabilities; bounded workspace reads; provider upload/auth/egress checks; cleanup/restart handling; no silent conversion to text or unsupported model requests.

tasks.title: Add bounded image region and resolution controls
acceptance: Deterministic crop/compression path, format/size validation, output references and clear inability to meet model limits; image transformations tested on decoded pixels.

tasks.title: Protect edits with fresh session read fingerprints
acceptance: Use existing read-set authority; record fingerprints on model reads; refuse stale or missing read before replacing an existing file; share with appropriate session continuations; preserve new-file creation, formatting, worktree confinement and permission decisions.

tasks.title: Expose atomic multi-edit and patch operations
acceptance: Validate every edit first; no partial application on conflict/failure; use existing workspace transaction/journal and evidence invalidation; preserve path-specific approval and restore after crash.

tasks.title: Complete lexical search/glob output and paging options
acceptance: Context lines, files/count modes, pagination and readback of oversized output; ignore semantics and incomplete-search reporting; no cursor skips or unbounded memory.

tasks.title: Add validated item-template subagent fan-out and aggregation
acceptance: Extend existing subagent registry, not another scheduler; bounded items/concurrency/spawn budget; resume identities, cancellation, isolated writes, per-item reports and no implicit model override.

tasks.title: Support multi-question and multi-select forms
acceptance: Versioned structured form through existing durable approval/input wait; terminal, headless and ACP adapters; validate options, partial responses, cancellation and restart.

tasks.title: Complete plugin package installation and lifecycle
acceptance: Install/update/remove local or repository packages with provenance, immutable content identity and explicit trust; discover contributed skills/agents/MCP/tools through existing policy; marketplace index is bounded and cannot grant authority.

tasks.title: Add authenticated HTTP/WebSocket API over the kernel
acceptance: Session/events/turn/approval/cancel/file API forwards existing kernel operations; same projections and durable IDs; loopback default, token auth, origin limits, bounded frames and reconnect cursors; SDK integration.

tasks.title: Build a browser session and file-review client
acceptance: Chat streaming, history, sessions, files/diffs, approvals/questions, model and job controls, responsive layout; browser only projects kernel state; end-to-end workflow and accessibility checks.

tasks.title: Add authenticated remote control with recovery
acceptance: Configurable relay or authenticated tunnel, device identity, explicit pairing and revocation; reconnect without replaying effects, session ownership/takeover and no public unauthenticated control.

tasks.title: Add validated session import and revocable sharing
acceptance: Import from versioned RapidLM export without replaying side effects or granting trust; bound/validate event identities; explicit share/redact/revoke and local preview before publication.

tasks.title: Add GitHub issue/PR workflow integration
acceptance: Configured authenticated CLI/CI workflow over existing session runtime; explicit issue/PR targeting, cancellation, checks and output artifacts; posting/pushing only when user-authorized.

tasks.title: Validate terminal customization, packaging and release channels
acceptance: Inspect remaining custom theme and accessibility differences; verify installers/update artifacts on clean supported platforms; record unsigned/unpublished external steps rather than fake success.

tasks.title: Carry native caching, thinking and opaque reasoning state
acceptance: Anthropic cache breakpoints and thinking controls reach the wire when explicitly configured; Responses encrypted reasoning items survive tool calls, session resume and approval suspension through typed bounded provider state; no private reasoning is rendered as answer text; replay and usage regressions.

tasks.title: Decode supported text encodings with explicit loss diagnostics
acceptance: UTF-8 and UTF-16 LE/BE BOMs decoded consistently; malformed sequences produce a visible loss warning on every affected page; long-line and tail continuation positions refer to decoded text; write freshness remains based on original bytes; bounds enforced before allocation.

tasks.title: Run final parity, platform and regression acceptance
acceptance: Full post-change workspace tests, formatting, clippy and SDK checks; Linux/Windows supported-platform checks; representative same-model task runs only with recorded models/config/budgets and usable credentials; every gap closed with evidence or explicitly awaiting external state.
